title: 3 Ensuite Bedroom Townhouse (2 Miles to Downtown)
description:
New 3-story Townhouse in hip East Nashville, less than 3 miles from Broadway. Convenient 2 car enclosed garage on the first floor, featuring 2250 sq ft of living space, a huge open floor living/kitchen/dining area, 3 large bedrooms each with their own ensuite. Out the front door is a peaceful serene courtyard, while behind is a paved entry leading to a private 2 car garage. Perfect for multiple couples or families visiting Nash! House is cleaned only with natural & organic cleaning supplies.

The space
A three story town house with a minimal Scandinavian style in the heart of East Nashville equipped with a private garage. A spacious bathroom and shower attached to each bedroom makes this house the perfect vacation rental for couples traveling together. An open floor plan in the kitchen and living/dining area with bountiful natural light is a stunning spot to enjoy your morning coffee, watch movies, cook meals, or play games.  
Walking distance from a gorgeous spa. A bounty of Nashville’s best food and coffee within a mile.

Guest access
You'll have complete private access to the entire 3 master bedroom townhouse and garage. We will provide code access for the garage as well as the front door.
